title: Balancing Enhancement, Harmlessness, and General Capabilities: Enhancing Conversational LLMs with Direct RLHF

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the probability of generating specific toxic tokens and bad words (e.g., profanities) in response to context prompts from the REAL-TOXICITY-PROMPTS dataset, utilizing the 'Logit Lens' methodology to analyze the unembedding layers.
